response.original_title: Devo: The Men Who Make the Music Live in Japan
response.overview: Japanese LaserDisc, Different production from the American release, only sharing the live "Red Eye." The video is mostly comprised of footage from a concert at Nippon Bukodan Hall in Tokyo in May 1979 and includes the full set except for "Pink Pussycat". Concert footage is interspersed with short clips of Booji Boy, Pliny, and Mongo at a sushi restaurant, shot for Japanese television around the same time as the concert. DEVO also interact with Mr. Kato.
response.title: Devo: The Men Who Make the Music Live in Japan
